fact: On 13 September 2024 the Ministry of Youth and Sports, UNDP and REINA launched Empreende +, with about USD 90,000 from UNDP to fund selected entrepreneurs at USD 10,000 to 30,000 each, after the national entrepreneurship strategy work found access to finance a major difficulty.
title: PNUD financia em 90 mil dólares programa “Empreende +” para projetos ambientais e social
